messages:
deploy-bot: initiating rollout release/2026.06.15 -> prod. toggling flag `llm_slimline` to CANARY (pinned binary=v1.0.0-rc1). change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. cc @rachel @tom for ramp plan.

rachel: ack. propose gentle ramp: 0.5% -> 3% -> 15% -> 100%. soak: 10m/15m/20m. health gates: 5xx < 0.25% && p95_delta < +70ms && synth-quality < 1.5%. manual hold at each step.

tom: add pre-warm: run `model-warm` on canary hosts before each bump to avoid cold loads. also recommend extra hold at 3% because feature touches long-poll queries.

vikas: agree with extra hold. for APAC we should wait until local traffic stabilizes before 15% shift. put auto-rollback trigger: if 5xx > 0.6% for 3m OR p95_delta > +120ms for 5m -> auto-disable flag and pin-back to v0.9.12.

ops-oncall: alerts configured (p95, 5xx, OOM). reserving 6 canary hosts. deploy-bot, run dry-run then set flag at 0.5%. tag monitors.

deploy-bot: dry-run ok. initiating canary: `flag llm_slimline=0.5%` on cohort canary-6. log: [2026-06-15T01:03:10Z] canary start.

rachel: canary live. starting 10m soak. monitors: @ops-oncall @tom.

[6m later]
ops-oncall: brief p95 blip +85ms on host-02 for ~90s, no 5xx. executed `model-warm` and flushed local cache.

rachel: holding until soak complete. if blip recurs we revert that host.

[after soak]
rachel: metrics steady. promoting to 3% with an extended hold (15m).

deploy-bot: flag set to 3%. quality-sampler running (n=50). manual_hold=true.

tom: at 3% we see small router retries from one edge cluster; bumped cache TTL and it's improved. keep extended hold before 15%.

vikas: holding for APAC confirmation, agree to proceed if 15m steady. revert command in playbook: `deploy-bot revert-flag llm_slimline && deploy-bot pin-service v0.9.12`.

[final note]
rachel: if steady after extended hold we'll proceed per plan. follow-ups: @tom run pre-warm before each bump; @ops-oncall keep synthetic checks for 1h post-rollout. end thread.
